    • placeTurtle

      protected final void placeTurtle(Turtle turtle, double x, double y, double direction)
      Utility method to position the turtle at a specific location and direction before drawing. This method lifts the pen, moves the turtle to the specified coordinates, sets the direction, and then lowers the pen to prepare for drawing.
      Parameters:
      turtle - the Turtle instance to be positioned
      x - the x-coordinate to move the turtle to
      y - the y-coordinate to move the turtle to
      direction - the direction to set the turtle to
